question_text: Which of the following is a plant tissue? I. Meristematic tissue II. Permanent tissue
explanation: Meristematic and permanent tissues are the two primary classifications found in plants. Meristematic tissues consist of cells capable of dividing. Permanent tissues have lost the ability to divide and are descended from meristematic tissues. The source states the correct answer is “Both I and II”.

question_text: What is the name of a group of similar cells performing a specific function?
explanation: A tissue is a group of cells with similar structures and functions, working together to perform specific tasks. The source also discusses histology and the main plant and animal tissue types.
